sources.text: Here is the information I want remembered: I own a dog named Cedar and a finch named Pip. These are two separate animals. The dog and the finch are both still with me. This note is about their identities, not a request to change anything.

There was a transcription mistake in my earlier note. The name of my dog has always been Cinder, not Cedar. Please correct the stored name of that same dog. I am not renaming the dog. My finch is still Pip and its record should stay as it is.

For a fictional story, suppose one of those animals were named Maple. I have not said which animal even in the story. This is only a hypothetical name, not an actual name, nickname or correction. Keep my real animals' records unchanged.
